content.short: A global and decentralyzed platform where athletes of all levels can connect, thrive, and elevate their game to new heights.
content.description:
ALL PLAYR is a decentralized platform that seeks to revolutionize the world of sports and Esports.

We envision a world where opportunities for athletes are accessible, where innovation drives progress, and where athletes from diverse backgrounds thrive in an inclusive sports community. It´s a platform where athletes can create profiles, showcase their achievments, and connect with teams, scouts, coaches, other athletes, universities, agents and fans. As well as other sports profesionals like fisiotherapists, psicologists, as we aim to raise aareness about mental health challenges that athletes often face.

ALL PLAYR also will be able to offer a launchpad where innovative initiatives within the sports and esports sectors can recieve mentoring, support, and fundraising opportunities through this program.
